chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Fārisī, from Abū Ḥanīfah Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from al-Walīd ibn Abān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muskān, from his father, who said:

Indeed, Fāṭimah bint Asad came to Abū Ṭālib to give him glad tidings of the birth of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), so Abū Ṭālib said: “Be patient for a sabt, and I shall give you glad tidings of one like him, except for prophethood.”
And he said: “The sabt is thirty years, and between the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) and Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) there were thirty years.”

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, referring to ʿAlī (عليه السلام)
key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet, referring here to the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله)
key_terms.النُّبُوَّةَ: prophethood, which is excluded from the likeness mentioned
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله)
key_terms.سَبْتًا: a term explained in the hadith as meaning thirty years
key_terms.مَوْلِدِ: the birth or nativity being announced in the report

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in al-Kāfī say about the thirty-year interval between the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله) and Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a report from Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) about the birth of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله) and a statement of Abū Ṭālib foretelling the coming of one like him except in prophethood. It presents a biographical and theological indication of the distinguished station of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام), noting the thirty-year interval between him and the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله).

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin yahya Al Farsy, from Abu Haneefa Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Waleed Bin Aban, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Muskan, from his father who said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Fatima<sup>asws</sup> Bint Asad<sup>as</sup> came over to Abu Talib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> in order to give him<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> the glad tidings of the Nazool (Coming) of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>. So Abu Talib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> said: ‘Be patient for a ‘Sabta’, I<sup>as</sup> shall give you<sup>as</sup> glad tidings similar to it, except for the Prophet-hood’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The ‘Sabt’ is of thirty years, and between Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was (a span of) thirty years’.
en.sarwar: Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) was born thirty years after the year of elephant. He was martyred in month of Ramadan twenty first Sunday night in the year fortieth after Hijra (migration). He was sixty three years at that time. He lived for thirty years after the death of the Holy Prophet (s.a). His mother was Fatima daughter of Asad Ibrahimn Hashim ibn ‘Abd Manaf. He was the first person whose both parents belonged to Hashim.
